plain_statement.zh: 在原 BMOR 前提下将固定主弧 105 到 140 的薄带能量限制在 9n/40 以内
plain_statement.en: Bound the energy on the fixed 105-to-140 major-arc collar by 9n/40 under the original BMOR estimate

brief.zh: 分母仍为 1 至 105，半宽从 105/(qn) 扩到 140/(qn)。对所有 n≥4×10¹⁸，估计实际 von Mangoldt 和的薄带能量及其带符号积分。用小相位上的正弦下界改进几何和，再对各分母分别为模型与误差选择有理权。宽弧真补集的实部下界 −63n/40 足以恢复 FR-9015 的 −9n/5。可导入推荐的已验证模块。
brief.en: Keep denominators 1 through 105 and increase the half-width from 105/(qn) to 140/(qn). Bound the actual von Mangoldt energy and signed integral on the collar for every n ≥ 4×10¹⁸. Refine the geometric sum with a small-angle sine estimate and balance the model and error separately at each denominator using rational weights. A floor of −63n/40 on the complement of the wider arcs suffices for the −9n/5 floor in FR-9015. The recommended verified modules can be imported.
